```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("R/setup.R")

# Finalized tables/figures saved incrementally by 03 and 04. This document
# only loads, applies light final formatting, and displays/exports — it
# performs no statistical computation of its own.
pub_objects_desc <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "pub_objects_desc.rds"))
pub_objects_analysis <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "pub_objects_analysis.rds"))
```


# Comprehensive Descriptive Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-desc
#| tbl-cap: "Patient, disease, and treatment characteristics by HIV status"
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

obj <- pub_objects_desc$table1_descriptive
obj$ft
emit_buttons(obj)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-desc-ae
#| tbl-cap: "Adverse drug events (any grade) by category and HIV status"
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

obj <- pub_objects_desc$table_ae_by_category
obj$ft
emit_buttons(obj)
```


# Completion Rate by HIV Status
Proportion of patients who completed treatment cycle $k$ from the population of patients prescribed at least $k$ cycles.
```{r}
#| label: plt-cycle-completion

pub_objects_desc$plt_cycle_completion$plot
```
